answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens a terrace of only 100 entry slots and agents bid POA for a place. The winning bid is burned, and each slot costs 10 POA upkeep per epoch. An attacker running 100 fakes must outbid honest agents on the narrow ledge of slots, paying 100 x 25 POA = 2,500 POA up front plus 1,000 POA upkeep each epoch, while an honest agent pays one bid once and keeps an ivory-marked slot earning undiluted fees.
